title: Group status order gives away last seen status
body:
Hello, 
I am using the latest telegram version and have my online status private (i.e. Last seen recently.), however when in groups, you can still see an estimate of when I was last online.

Example:
Let's say I was online 5 mins ago, user A was online 4 minutes ago and user B was online 6 minutes ago. On the group users list I will appear between those two users and with that you can see my exact status which is not very private.

Thank you.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @MiguelSOliveira You local online status is updated for users when you send a message there — you become online for about 30 seconds. That way the status may change inside group list. But otherwise the sorting is the same as the phrases used (last seen recently — about three days), the app doesn't "know the real status, but hides it" — this would be a privacy issue, the app really doesn't know those last seen times — so it can't show the right position in chat participants list anyway.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
The problem comes when a user that has this option deactivated (i.e. last seen status public). 
He sees something like:

User A - last seen 1 minute ago
Me - last seen recently
user B - last seen 3 minutes ago

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @MiguelSOliveira If you hide your last seen status from someone he doesn't have the exact last seen time in his app — no matter did he hide his last seen status from you or not. Only way this can happen is if he had your last seen status visible not too long ago (before you hide it) and uses that value or if his app saw some your action (like message was sent by you or typing was sent by you) and it updated your last seen status to that value.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
![ex](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/8149533/24810344/08c5353e-1bba-11e7-816e-e4578f07607b.png)
I'm not saying he has the exact value. I'm saying he has an interval of my last seen status.
From the example I gave above, anyone can see that I was online between 1 to 3 minutes ago.

I'm saying someone with hidden status should always appear on the bottom of the users list, unless he is online.

I may be wrong and this is indeed how it is supposed to be like and in that case I stand corrected.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @MiguelSOliveira He doesn't see this interval unless he receives it somehow. He can receive it by two ways: (1) he received it before he was restricted to your last seen status. (2) he saw some your action, visible to him, that triggered that you're online, like a new message or a typing action.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Yes, he saw it because of option 2.. 
But the moment I go offline, shouldn't my name go to the bottom of the list ?
